warnings: MARK USED BUT NOT SCHEDULED, BOTH WAYS - CHECKED. The index lists 25 sheets (17 A + 4 S + 2 E + 2 SN) and the title block prints จำนวนแผ่น 17, which counts the architectural set only. The scanned book has 27 pages: cover (หน้า01) + 25 indexed sheets + one sheet the index does not list, S-01/1 แปลนฐานรากแผ่ (หน้า20). Page-to-sheet mapping is therefore หน้า02=A-01 .. หน้า18=A-17, หน้า19=S-01, หน้า20=S-01/1, หน้า21=S-02, หน้า22=S-03, หน้า23=S-04, หน้า24=E-01, หน้า25=E-02, หน้า26=SN-01, หน้า27=SN-02, and it closes exactly.

S-01/1 (หน้า20) is a real, signed, numbered sheet carrying its own title block (แผ่นที่ S-01/1, จำนวนแผ่น 4) - it is an alternative spread-footing design offered when the soil bearing capacity is adequate, not a duplicate of S-01. It being absent from the index is the index's omission, not a missing page.
The title block's จำนวนแผ่น differs per discipline (17 on A sheets, 4 on S sheets), so it is a per-discipline sheet count, not a set total.
